description: Session context window management: auto-compact, health visibility, manual recovery, exhaustion detection, and workflow retry health guard

tasks.title: Add compaction configuration to runner agent config and forward to ACP sessions
tasks.description: Extend AgentConfig in acp-agent.ts with a compaction field (threshold, strategy). Forward compaction configuration to ACP connection options. Handle compaction notifications from the ACP server by extracting before/after usage metrics and emitting appropriate session events. Add default compaction config values.
acceptanceCriteria: AgentConfig includes optional compaction field with threshold (0-1) and strategy ('summary')
Compaction config is forwarded to ACP session creation and resume calls
Default compaction config (threshold 0.8, strategy 'summary') is used when not explicitly set
Compaction notifications from ACP server are captured with before/after context usage and persisted as usage.updated events
Unit tests verify config forwarding for createSession and resumeSession paths
Unit tests verify default compaction config is applied when not specified
tasks.output: Compaction config flows from AgentConfig through ACP connection to opencode sessions; compaction events observable in session event stream
tasks.notes: Modifies packages/runner/src/actions/acp-agent.ts: AgentConfig interface, runAcpWorkflowAgentSession, and buildUsageUpdatePayload. Also updates acp-connection.ts session options if needed.

tasks.title: Implement session compact and reset backend orchestration with API endpoints
tasks.description: Add CompactAsync() and ResetAsync() grain methods to AgentSessionGrain that orchestrate: close existing ACP session, build summary from session messages (compact) or start fresh (reset), open new ACP session, update coder session record with new acpSessionId, persist compaction event in stream log. Add POST endpoints for compact and reset under IssueRoutes.Sessions. Add ContextUsagePercent computed field to AgentSessionReadModels DTOs.
acceptanceCriteria: CompactAsync() closes existing ACP session, builds a summary of task instructions/key decisions/errors, opens new session with summary as initial context
ResetAsync() closes existing ACP session, opens new session with only system prompt
Both methods return updated context window metrics (contextWindowSize, contextWindowUsed, contextUsagePercent)
Both methods throw when the session is actively running (detected via session status)
Compaction event is persisted as session_stream_log row with eventType 'compaction' and before/after context usage
POST /api/projects/{ref}/issues/{number}/sessions/{name}/compact returns 200 with updated metrics on success, 409 if session is active, 404 if not found
POST /api/projects/{ref}/issues/{number}/sessions/{name}/reset returns 200 with cleared metrics on success, 409 if session is active, 404 if not found
AgentSessionReadModels DTOs include contextUsagePercent computed field
Integration tests verify compact and reset API endpoints return correct responses for active/inactive/not-found sessions
Unit tests verify AgentSessionGrain.CompactAsync and ResetAsync correctly orchestrate session lifecycle transitions
tasks.output: Fully functional compact and reset operations accessible via HTTP API; compact events persisted in session stream logs; DTOs include context usage percentage
tasks.notes: Modifies AgentSessionGrain.cs (add CompactAsync, ResetAsync, compaction event persistence), IssueRoutes.Sessions.cs (add compact/reset endpoints), AgentSessionReadModels.cs (add ContextUsagePercent). Consider extracting summarization logic into a helper to keep the grain focused.

tasks.title: Implement context exhaustion failure classification on session close
tasks.description: Add classification logic in the session close handler that inspects final context window metrics. When a session closes with status 'failed' and contextWindowUsed/contextWindowSize exceeds 90%, set failureCategory to 'context_exhaustion'. Add a secondary rapid-completion heuristic for sessions completing in under 10 seconds without expected output at >85% usage. Emit context_health_update SSE events when health status crosses color thresholds. Wire the new failure category through error display surfaces (session detail, task results, CLI output).
acceptanceCriteria: Session close with failed status and >90% context usage is classified as failureCategory 'context_exhaustion'
Session close with failed status and <90% context usage retains existing failureCategory (probe_timeout, etc.)
Rapid completion (<10s) without artifacts at >85% usage is flagged as suspected context exhaustion
context_health_update SSE event is emitted when context usage crosses green/yellow/red thresholds (60%, 80%)
compaction_event SSE event is emitted through TranscriptEventPublisher when compaction occurs
Both new event types are registered in backend ALL_EVENT_TYPES
Exhaustion classification does not apply to successfully completed sessions
Failure category 'context_exhaustion' appears in session detail API responses
Unit tests verify classification logic for exhausted/non-exhausted/rapid-completion scenarios
Integration tests verify SSE events are emitted with correct payloads for threshold crossings
tasks.output: Context exhaustion failures are properly classified; new SSE events (compaction_event, context_health_update) flow to frontend clients
tasks.notes: Modifies AgentSessionGrain.cs (close handler classification, SSE event emission), events.ts (register new event types). Depends on T-002 because compact/reset infrastructure must be in place to avoid merge conflicts in AgentSessionGrain.cs.

tasks.title: Add workflow retry session health guard
tasks.description: Modify the workflow retry path to inspect the associated session's context window usage before allowing retry. If usage exceeds 80%, reject the retry with an error message suggesting Compact or Reset. If usage is 80-90%, log a warning but allow retry to proceed. Add task dispatch health evaluation that blocks dispatch at >90% usage. Surface context health indicators in workflow session lists via existing DTOs.
acceptanceCriteria: WorkflowGrain.RetryAsync() checks associated session's context usage before proceeding
Retry is rejected with error 'Session context is near capacity (X%). Compact or reset the session before retrying.' when usage > 90%
Retry is accepted with a warning log when usage is 80-90%
Retry proceeds normally when usage is < 80% or no context data exists
Task dispatch blocks with clear reason when session usage exceeds 90%
Workflow session list entries include context health summary data
Suggested recovery actions (compact, reset) are returned in the retry rejection error response
Unit tests verify retry rejection/warning/acceptance at each threshold boundary
Integration tests verify end-to-end retry flow: exhausted → rejected → compact → retry succeeds
tasks.output: Workflow retry blocks when session context is exhausted; workflow session lists show context health indicators
tasks.notes: Modifies WorkflowGrain.cs (RetryAsync), WorkflowRun.Failure.cs (accept context_exhaustion reason). Also touches workflow session query/DTO paths. Depends on T-003 for context_exhaustion failure category to be defined.

tasks.title: Implement context health display UI: usage bar, warning banner, list indicators, and timeline entries
tasks.description: Create ContextHealthBar component showing token usage as 'used / total (percent%)' with color-coded bar (green <60%, yellow 60-80%, red >80%). Add warning banner above session transcript when usage exceeds 80% with Compact/Reset action links. Render compaction events as info banners in SessionTimeline. Add compact health indicators (colored dot + percentage) to session list views. Register compaction_event and context_health_update SSE event types in frontend registries. Wire live SSE updates to refresh health display.
acceptanceCriteria: ContextHealthBar renders usage as '450K / 1M tokens (45%)' with green bar at low usage
ContextHealthBar color transitions: green (<60%), yellow (60-80%), red (>80%)
Warning banner appears above transcript when context usage > 80%
Warning banner includes actionable links for Compact and Reset
Warning banner auto-dismisses when usage drops below 80% via SSE update
Compaction events appear as info-style timeline entries in SessionTimeline with before/after token counts
Session list entries show colored dot indicator with usage percentage for each session
Sessions with no context data (contextWindowSize=0) hide the health indicator
compaction_event and context_health_update are registered in AGENT_DETAIL_EVENTS, useSSE eventTypes, and event-bus EventMap
Health bar updates in real-time via SSE context_health_update events during live sessions
Component tests verify color transitions at threshold boundaries
Component tests verify warning banner appears and dismisses correctly
Component tests verify compaction timeline entries render with correct before/after data
tasks.output: ContextHealthBar component, warning banner, compaction timeline entries, session list health indicators; SSE event type registrations; all visible on session and workflow pages
tasks.notes: Creates ContextHealthBar.tsx; modifies SessionTimeline.tsx, useSessionTimeline.ts, coder-session/model/types.ts, agent/model/types.ts, agent/model/events.ts, session list views. Depends on T-002 for API data shape and T-003 for SSE events to be emitted.

tasks.title: Implement session recovery actions UI: Compact/Reset buttons, confirmation dialog, and API client integration
tasks.description: Create SessionRecoveryActions component with Compact and Reset buttons. Both buttons are disabled when session is actively running with tooltip explanation. Reset shows a confirmation dialog warning about context loss. Add compactSession() and resetSession() API client functions. Integrate both components into the session detail page. After successful compact or reset, refresh session metrics and transcript display.
acceptanceCriteria: Compact and Reset buttons are visible on session detail page
Both buttons are disabled with tooltip 'Unavailable while session is active' when session status is running
Both buttons are enabled when session is completed, failed, cancelled, or probing
Clicking Compact calls POST /api/.../sessions/{name}/compact and refreshes context usage bar
Clicking Reset opens confirmation dialog with text 'This will clear all session context. The agent will lose all conversation history.'
Confirmation dialog has Cancel and 'Reset Session' buttons
Confirming Reset calls POST /api/.../sessions/{name}/reset and refreshes session page
Cancelling Reset closes the dialog without making any API call
Error responses (409 active, 404 not found) are shown to the user as inline error messages
API client exposes compactSession(issueNumber, sessionName) and resetSession(issueNumber, sessionName) functions
Component tests verify button disabled/enabled states for each session status
Component tests verify confirmation dialog open/confirm/cancel flow
Component tests verify API calls are made with correct parameters and errors are displayed
tasks.output: SessionRecoveryActions component with Compact/Reset buttons and confirmation dialog; API client functions; integrated into session detail page
tasks.notes: Creates SessionRecoveryActions.tsx; modifies coder-session/api/client.ts (add compactSession, resetSession), session detail page. Depends on T-002 for API endpoints to exist.
